data.text:
POWER BANK, SUMABOG SA SENADO

Sumabog ang isang power bank sa bahagi ng Bills and Index office ng Senado sa Pasay City bandang 3:50 p.m. ngayong Huwebes, Jan. 22.

Gumamit umano ng fire extinguisher ang isang empleyado upang apulahin ang sumabog na power bank.

Bandang 4:05 p.m. nang dumating ang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) upang inspeksyunin ang naturang area. Idineklarang under control ang insidente kasunod nito.

Matatandaang nagkasunog sa Senado noong November 2025. I via Maeanne Los Baños-Oroceo

DAVAO HAS WORST TRAFFIC IN THE PH 🚗

Davao City continues to be the most traffic-congested city in the Philippines, placing 12th worldwide in the 2025 TomTom Traffic Index. 

The report also identified the Philippines as the most congested country in Asia.

Manila likewise appeared on the list, ranking 40th globally, though it recorded a slight improvement compared to the previous year.
